import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long powerMod(long base, int exp, int mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(powerMod(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        long[] fact = new long[n + 1];
        long[] invFact = new long[n + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % p;
        }
        invFact[n] = powerMod(fact[n], p - 2, p);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = (invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p;
        }

        long[][] g = new long[n + 1][17];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(g[i], 0);
        }
        g[0][0] = 1;

        int[] count = {0};

        // Recursive function equivalent
        class RecurseSolve {
            void recurse(int nVal, List<Integer> bits, int index, int mask) {
                if (index == bits.size()) {
                    count[0]++;
                    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) {
                        g[nVal][i] += invFact[mask] * g[nVal ^ mask][i - 1];
                        if (count[0] >= 8) g[nVal][i] %= p;
                    }
                    if (count[0] >= 8) count[0] = 0;
                    return;
                }
                recurse(nVal, bits, index + 1, mask);
                recurse(nVal, bits, index + 1, mask ^ (1 << bits.get(index)));
            }
        }

        RecurseSolve rs = new RecurseSolve();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((i & n) != i) continue;
            List<Integer> bits = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 18; j++) {
                if (((1 << j) & i) != 0) {
                    bits.add(j);
                }
            }
            if (!bits.isEmpty()) {
                rs.recurse(i, bits, 0, 1 << bits.get(0));
            }
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        int limit = Math.min(16, k);
        for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            g[n][i] %= p;
            long val = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p;
            val = val * fact[k] % p;
            val = val * invFact[k - i] % p;
            totalSum = (totalSum + val) % p;
        }

        long totalPow = powerMod(k, n, p);
        long finalRes = totalPow - totalSum;
        if (finalRes < 0) finalRes += p;
        System.out.println(finalRes);
    }
}
